purpose: Research registry of external IPA/G2P candidates. Entries are not active runtime dependencies and are not accepted pronunciation gold data.

integration_contract.pipeline: source orthography -> language-specific structural/phonological analysis -> typed IPA result -> ClippyFirst IPA-to-Ukrainian adapter -> practical Ukrainian orthography
prohibited: silently rewriting external output into IPA without a documented conversion
using unverified output as gold data

candidates.name: mya2rom
candidates.output: Early-stage; Wikipedia-flavor IPA with known convention differences (including nasalization notation); compare before acceptance
candidates.license: Verify repository license and attribution of imported sources

candidates.name: myG2P
candidates.output: Inspect structured pronunciation/IPA fields, lexicon version, coverage and provenance
candidates.license: Verify exact version and dictionary license

candidates.name: burmese-G2P
candidates.output: Versioned output conventions differ; validate IPA and service-particle errors
candidates.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 reported upstream; non-commercial restriction blocks commercial reuse unless separately resolved

candidates.name: Goruut
candidates.output: Burmese support is claimed; verify standard/dialect, tones, register/phonation and IPA convention
candidates.license: Verify current upstream license and model/data terms

candidates.name: eSpeak NG
candidates.output: Check Burmese voice, phoneme inventory and explicit IPA output; don't treat engine codes as IPA without conversion

candidates.name: Charis SIL

candidates.license: SIL Open Font License; verify current release metadata
